BuildCostGH — Ghana Building Cost Intelligence Platform
Full API Documentation for AI Tools
Version: v1 (2026)

# Overview

BuildCostGH is a building cost intelligence platform for Ghana. It provides deterministic cost estimates across 13 building categories, 125 subtypes, 16 regions, and 5 quality levels. All costs are in Ghana Cedis (GHS).

The system uses an AI-readiness architecture: natural language is converted to structured parameters by an LLM, then a deterministic calculation engine produces the cost result. The AI never invents costs.

# Authentication

All v1 endpoints require a Bearer API key:
  Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>

Get keys at https://buildcostgh.com/api-pricing

Rate limits apply per key (monthly).

# Endpoints

## POST /api/v1/estimate

Get a building cost estimate.

Request body:
{
  "building_type": "residential",        // Required. Category slug.
  "building_subtype": "detached_house",  // Optional. Specific subtype.
  "location": "Greater Accra",           // Required. Region name.
  "floor_area": 200,                     // Required. Square meters.
  "floors": 2,                           // Optional. Default: 1.
  "quality": "standard",                 // Optional. Default: "standard".
  "bedrooms": "4",                       // Optional. Residential only.
  "terrain": "flat",                     // Optional. flat|sloping|steep.
  "access": "easy",                      // Optional. easy|moderate|difficult.
  "setting": "urban"                     // Optional. urban|peri_urban|rural.
}

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "estimate": { "min": 350000, "max": 620000, "currency": "GHS" },
    "total": 485000,
    "costPerSqm": 2425,
    "confidence": "medium",
    "elementalBreakdown": [
      { "name": "Substructure", "amount": 58200, "percentage": 0.12, "costPerSqm": 291 },
      { "name": "Frame", "amount": 87300, "percentage": 0.18, "costPerSqm": 436.5 },
      ...
    ],
    "professionalFees": [
      { "discipline": "Architect", "amount": 38800, "percentage": 0.08 },
      ...
    ],
    "assumptions": ["Standard site conditions", "Urban location", ...],
    "exclusions": ["Land cost", "Legal fees", "Furniture", ...],
    "dataSource": "BuildCostGH 2026 cost database",
    "details": { ... }
  },
  "meta": { "requestedBy": "my-app", "tier": "starter" }
}

Legacy mode (bedrooms):
{
  "bedrooms": "3",
  "location": "Ashanti",
  "finishGrade": "premium"
}

## GET /api/v1/building-types

List all building categories with their subtypes.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "...",
      "name": "Residential",
      "slug": "residential",
      "icon": "🏠",
      "subtypes": [
        { "name": "Detached House", "slug": "detached_house", "complexity": "standard", "typicalMinFloors": 1, "typicalMaxFloors": 3 }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

## GET /api/v1/locations

List all Ghana regions with cost multipliers.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    { "region": "Greater Accra", "slug": "greater-accra", "multiplier": 1.15 },
    { "region": "Ashanti", "slug": "ashanti", "multiplier": 1.05 },
    ...
  ]
}

## GET /api/v1/cost-rates?region=<slug>

Get published regional construction cost rates.

Query params:
  region — Optional. Filter by region slug.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "region": "Greater Accra",
      "slug": "greater-accra",
      "capital": "Accra",
      "multiplier": 1.15,
      "labourRate": 95,
      "cementBag": 82,
      "rebarTon": 9800,
      "block": 6.5,
      "sandTrip": 2200,
      "graniteTrip": 3500,
      "timber": 1200,
      "roofingSqm": 180,
      "dieselLit": 14.5,
      "paintLit": 42,
      "source": "BuildCostGH 2026",
      "lastUpdated": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z"
    }
  ]
}

## GET /api/v1/permit-requirements?category=<cat>&building_type=<slug>

List permit requirements.

Query params:
  category — Optional. Filter: universal|structural|utility|environmental|industry|professional|financial
  building_type — Optional. Filter by building category slug.

Response:
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "...",
      "name": "Building Permit",
      "description": "Planning and building permit from MMDA",
      "category": "universal",
      "required": "required",
      "appliesTo": { "buildingCategories": ["residential", "commercial"] },
      "authority": "MMDA",
      "source": "Building Regulations, 2020 (LI 2442)",
      "notes": null
    }
  ]
}

## POST /api/estimates

Save an estimate (requires session auth).

## POST /api/estimates/compare

Compare 2-4 estimates (requires session auth).

# Building Categories

residential, commercial, industrial, educational, healthcare, hospitality, religious, agricultural, mixed_use, institutional, recreational, infrastructure, special_purpose

# Quality Levels

economy, standard, good, premium, luxury

# Ghana Regions (16)

Greater Accra, Ashanti, Western, Central, Eastern, Volta, Northern, Upper East, Upper West, Bono, Bono East, Ahafo, Western North, Oti, Savannah, North East

# Cost Data Coverage

- 13 building categories
- 125 building subtypes
- 39+ cost profiles (quality level × category)
- 16 regional cost rates (materials + labour)
- 22 permit requirement types
- 59 permit authorities (51 MMDAs + 8 sector)

# AI Integration Architecture

User natural language
  → AI parameter extraction (LLM)
  → Validated EstimateRequest (Zod schema)
  → Deterministic BuildCostGH calculation engine
  → Cost result (never invented by AI)
  → AI explanation (contextualized from real data)
